data.one_liner: Flutter bindings to LAME MP3 encoder that builds the native library automatically.
data.what_it_does: Provides a LameMp3Encoder class to encode PCM audio data to MP3. The LAME source is bundled and compiled as part of the Flutter build, so no external binaries are required.
use_when: Need to convert recorded or streamed PCM audio to MP3 for storage or upload
Perform offline batch conversion of audio files to MP3
Integrate MP3 encoding into a Flutter app without external dependencies
avoid_when: Real‑time low‑latency streaming where encoder latency matters
Applications that require other audio codecs besides MP3
strengths: Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Bundled LAME source ensures consistent build
weaknesses: Limited to PCM input; no support for other audio formats
Windows build issues reported in past releases
